zh-CN: 修复黑夜与暮光主题下主题选择菜单白底浅色文字、选项难以辨认的问题。
扫描目录现在只生成队列；选择压缩或不压缩入库后，定时器才会执行任务。
相似项目会在读取 MD5 和入库前等待确认；精确重复只接受本次任务有效 MD5 的完整严格匹配。
修复扫描完成后统计提示滞留，并明确列出小项目过滤、非视频文件、链接和读取失败等未入队原因。
en-US: Fixes low-contrast theme menu options that appeared as light text on a white popup in Night and Twilight.
Directory scans now only fill the queue; scheduled processing starts only after compressed or uncompressed intake is explicitly selected.
Similar items wait for confirmation before MD5 or intake work, and exact duplicates require a complete strict match of current-task MD5 values.
Fixes stale scan progress and lists filtered small items, non-video files, links and unreadable items as separate skip reasons.
